name: NumPy GF(2), integer-XOR and original C++ BP+OSD
justification: No SEM model is fitted. lavaan/OpenMx cannot express exact binary-code algebra or this decoder. Python and original C++ implement the scientific object, not a substitute SEM estimator.
independent_validation: results/exact_checks.json verifies integer-XOR versus NumPy rank and all 256 small seed pairs. results/independent_checks.json compares 19 independently constructed Hx/metacheck matrices with original archives and uses a second phase representation.
